# Bloub animation engine

Vendored from [jeremy-prt/bloub](https://github.com/jeremy-prt/bloub) to animate
agent avatars in the mobile app: `src/components/Bloub.tsx` samples it for the
blinking, gaze, breathing and thinking-dot frames. The upstream source is MIT
licensed; see `LICENSE` in this directory and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` at the
project root.

Only the framework-free engine and its dependencies are copied here. The tests,
Vue components, cycles and export tooling are intentionally left out.
